description: This file defines a class 'Each' that implements a validation rule to check whether all elements in an iterable satisfy a specified rule. It is part of a validation framework within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the API v2 validator rules.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies every element in an iterable conforms to a specified composite rule.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a specific composite validation rule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all elements of the input iterable satisfy the rule; throws an error if input is not iterable.
